Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	xberg "github.com/xberg-io/xberg/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	input := xberg.ExtractInput{
		Kind:     ptr(xberg.ExtractInputKindURI),
		URI:      ptr(`https://example.com/text/report.txt`),
		MimeType: ptr(`text/plain`),
	}
	config := xberg.ExtractionConfig{
		Concurrency: &xberg.ConcurrencyConfig{
		MaxThreads: ptr(uint(8)),
	},
		Captioning:  &xberg.CaptioningConfig{
		Llm:          &xberg.LlmConfig{
		Model:          `openai/gpt-4o`,
		MaxConcurrency: ptr(uint(2)),
	},
		MinImageArea: 1000,
	},
	}
	result, err := xberg.Extract(input, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results[0].MimeType)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results[0].Content)
}
```
